guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：胡佛水壩水力發電系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System
guides.concept: 以厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫解析胡佛水壩水力發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System through thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hoover有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水輪工況map。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力水路暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識厚拱壩載荷路徑。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識供水與發電調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水庫與泥砂邊界。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify hoover effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine operating maps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify penstock transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify thick-arch load paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify water/power scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reservoir/sediment boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交供水與發電調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交水庫與泥砂邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交水庫與泥砂邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for water/power scheduling.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reservoir/sediment boundaries.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reservoir/sediment boundaries.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

practiceEn: Compare hoover effective head with coulee flow/head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
